title: webapp.service fails on every fresh boot, but restarting it always works
description_md:
`webapp.service` is supposed to come up automatically at boot, but on a clean start it's always `failed` -- and yet the moment you run `sudo systemctl restart webapp`, it comes up fine and stays up. It depends on a local data-init step that finishes a couple of seconds after boot, but nothing in `webapp.service` says so. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), figure out why a working restart doesn't mean the boot sequence is actually fixed, and make `webapp.service` genuinely wait for its dependency -- not just get lucky on a manual restart.

You're done when `webapp.service` is confirmed to correctly wait for `data-init.service` to complete before starting, even on a simulated fresh start.
